normalization_plan.reason: Staker address parameter directly selects the state mutated by slashStaker
The penalty parameter feeds the unchecked stake subtraction
Withdrawal amount parameter bounds the external token transfer
Periods parameter only affects the divided sub-stake duration
Sub-stake indices are only used to select storage slots in mergeStake
Worker parameter is written into stakerFromWorker and StakerInfo
Capsule bytes are consumed only by the adjudicator evaluation
CFrag bytes are hashed and deserialized inside evaluateCFrag
Precomputed data is only used by the verification path of evaluateCFrag
Extra data is forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback
Spender parameter is only written into the allowance mapping
Values array is only consumed by the batch deposit loop
Period local is an intermediate value inside slashStaker
Next period local is an intermediate value of the commitment logic
Locked tokens local is a transient check value in the commitment
Reward local is the return value of the penalty calculation
Sum accumulator is only meaningful for the batch deposit transfer
Hash local exists only to key evaluatedCFrags inside evaluateCFrag
StakerInfo pointer local is the storage handle used by withdraw
Sub-stake pointer local only exists while writing sub-stake storage
